title: Compare one feature with LDA
description: You fit a one-feature Gaussian classifier and compare its test accuracy with the stored LDA result.

steps.description: You select order[0] and keep that same feature in both data splits. Double brackets preserve a two-dimensional feature matrix.
You estimate each class's feature mean, sample variance, and prior fraction from training rows. The fitted object stores those arrays.

steps.question: Which score determines the predicted class index?
steps.answer: The largest Gaussian log-likelihood plus log prior wins. Each variance is bounded below by 1e-6 before scoring.

steps.description: You predict the test rows and compare accuracy with acc_te. The recording identifies petal length as the selected feature and reports 0.933 for this classifier versus 0.978 for LDA.
